messages:
Anna (CEO): Heads up — quick all-hands tomorrow 10:00am PT. 30m slot. Recording will be posted after. Please drop any must-cover items here.

Priya (Product): Agenda I propose: 1) Launch recap 2) Policy change summary 3) Roadmap callouts 4) Q&A (live + pre-submitted). OK?

Sam (Eng): Add single-slide on latency/cost tradeoffs for the Dedicated rollout pls. 2-3 bullets.

Jorge (Infra): I can show a one-slide view of the fallback routing behavior we enabled last week. Will have a tiny demo gif.

Maya (People Ops): Recording + captions will be posted to #all-hands after the meeting. I'll pin the doc and add the calendar recap. @here please add any personal time conflicts.

Anna (CEO): Great. Also short note on policy: we have an update to data retention for hosted logs — will summarize high-level and link to the policy doc. No action required from most teams; tagged teams will get follow-ups.

Priya (Product): For Q&A collection, folks can either speak during the live Q&A or add items here. If you want private/manager-only question, DM me and I'll route.

Sam (Eng): Quick logistics: can presenters drop slides to the deck by 8am tomorrow? Link: https://drive.redwood/teams/allhands/deck

Jorge (Infra): Deploy bot: scheduled rollout flagged, will post a short incident note if any blips.

Infra-bot: deploy-schedule set by @Jorge for service: runtime-proxy at 09:30 PT (canary). Status: scheduled.

Maya (People Ops): Reminder: child-care stipend update will be one slide from People Ops — short and non-actionable, but wanted to surface.

Anna (CEO): TL;DR on what I'm planning to say: 1) Quick kudos for Dedicated parity milestone 2) Why we're shifting retention limits (risk/compliance) 3) Roadmap highlight: private deployment improvements 4) Ask: keep shipping small, measurable ops wins.

Priya (Product): I've added 3 Qs from product folks below — please upvote if you want them asked live: 
- How will retention changes affect eval pipelines?
- Are we scheduling a migration window for dedicated customers?
- What telemetry will be available post-change?

Sam (Eng): +1 on telemetry question. Also: can we get a note on who to contact for emergency rollbacks? (maybe add to runbook slide)

Jorge (Infra): I'll include the emergency rollback contact on the infra slide (oncall + escalation matrix).

Maya (People Ops): Action: I'll post the recording link and the deck after the meeting. Please add speaker notes to slides for context.

Anna (CEO): OK team — final checklist: slides in by 8am, Qs here by 9:30am, presenters join 9:45am for quick tech check. Meeting at 10:00am.

Priya (Product): Also planning 5-minute demo clip for the new rolling policy UI — short and focused.

Sam (Eng): Minor: can we avoid long technical deep dives? This is company-wide. We'll have follow-up tech deep-dive session next week for infra/eng.

Anna (CEO): Agreed. Keep slides high-level; link to follow-up sessions for deep dives.

Maya (People Ops): Noted. I'll update the calendar description with the recording and follow-up links after the call.

Jorge (Infra): If anything blocks the deploy demo, I'll post a short status update in this thread.

Anna (CEO): Final: if you want me to call out your team wins during the all-hands, ping me here or DM before 9am. :tada:

Priya (Product): Adding two upvotes for the retention telemetry question from me and @Sam.

Sam (Eng): Thanks — will be there.

Maya (People Ops): I'll post the meeting recording here after it's processed: recording link will be `https://redwood.com/recordings/1741005555`

Anna (CEO): Thanks everyone — see you tomorrow.

Maya (People Ops) (follow-up message after meeting): Recording: https://redwood.com/recordings/1741005555 (captions on). Deck: https://drive.redwood/teams/allhands/deck/1741005555-deck.pdf. Key takeaways:
- Dedicated parity milestone shipped; ops team lowered tail latency 15%.
- Data retention policy updated: 90d default for hosted logs, exceptions by request.
- Roadmap: Private deploy UX improvements scheduled next quarter.
- Follow-up deep-dive sessions: infra deep-dive Thurs 2pm PT; product telemetry office hours Fri 11am PT.

Anna (CEO) (follow-up): Appreciate the quick meeting. If you want a mention or retrospective in the company newsletter, ping @Maya.

Priya (Product) (follow-up): Filed follow-up ticket for migration guidance doc: https://issues.redwood/RED-4821

Jorge (Infra) (follow-up): No regressions from the canary; rollout completed without incident. Posting short postmortem in #postmortems later today.

Sam (Eng) (follow-up): Adding perf baseline artifacts to the shared folder for teams to reference.

Maya (People Ops) (final): Closing thread — thanks for the prep work, everyone. :heart:
